title: Are you using Unreal Engine? I'd love to hear about what works for you.
author: hippieman
selftext: I'm a UE dev, and a plugin developer.  What works for you and your agents in UE and what's still a huge pain in the ass/blind spot?

comments.author: Xijamk
comments.body:
3D is pseudo solved with meshy/tripo+ai using blender and the new UV wrapping from tirpo is amazing, accurig is also good, for vfx astra is ok with niagara but not really good, animation is the worst by far, i've tried ardy, kiomdo, astra with blender, even the new "animation from mono video capture" from metahuman (which is the best).  
Also Astra with PCG and a lot of assets from fab library is doing less than I expected, but maybe is a skill issue from my part.

replies.author: DigitalDustChan
replies.body:
What type of animation?

I have an AI integrated animation plugin on unity, maybe I could port it to unreal. But it does procedural animation rather than character animation.

replies.author: hippieman
replies.body: How are you using Astra with UE?  MCP, or computer use? (I make a MCP plugin and Astra is my main agent).

replies.author: Xijamk
replies.body: [https://ue-mcp.com/](https://ue-mcp.com/) is the best mcp server out there

replies.author: JorgitoEstrella
replies.body: Stefan 3D AI on YouTube did the rigging with AI videos as references like in his scorpion for his rts game.

replies.author: Xijamk
replies.body: Yeah, I've tried that making video reference with minmaxh3 that I can run locally, I've tried video reference + ardy/kimodo/blenderviamcp, and it's not that great but it's coming close every day, astra with blender was a huge leap on animation, next iteration maybe...

replies.author: RemarkableGuidance44
replies.body: The hard part is making a great game and marketing it. With so many games coming out these days your chances are near zero to make a hit.

comments.author: CaptainAlexWest
comments.body: I use chatgpt chat to make prompts and figure out what to build in the project. Then I build in blocks and commit the block. I'm on unreal with vscode. I went from prototype to production in 2 months. It's working right now. Astra can super cook but the usage is potato again. I'm building a space single player game. Multiplayer games failed me.

comments.author: higherthantheroom
comments.body: Make the very simple animation tool, here's what I need from you, go download the free animals pack. Get the chicken, then I want it to auto generate animation montages that a regular chicken can do, such as walking, eating, pecking, clucking, and backflip. I struggled really hard, with understanding root motion, keying frames, and making recordings of already exiting characters, to give them new animation. I probably lack about 14 videos and 200 hours of practice. But I couldn't make the chicken do a good backflip when I was experimenting.
